MuPDF.js 1.27.0 (npm package "mupdf", unmodified) — Artifex Software
Source: https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf.js · MuPDF: https://mupdf.com / https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf
License: AGPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE.txt). Used by the ERP design-file splitter (lib/pdf-to-svg.ts) to turn .ai/.pdf/.eps pages into real vector SVG so pieces can be recolored later.
Loaded on demand (native ES module import) only when a user saves vector pieces — never bundled by webpack.
